hints.title: Deficit Computation
hints.text: For each bag, the additional rocks required to reach full capacity is capacity[i] - rocks[i].

hints.title: Ascending Greedy Order
hints.text: Sorting required deficits in ascending order ensures we fill bags with smallest deficits first.

hints.title: Resource Depletion
hints.text: Subtract each deficit from additionalRocks. As long as additionalRocks >= deficit, increment full bag tally.

hints.title: Sorted Deficit Greedy Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting deficit differences takes O(n log n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Filling larger deficits first wastes resources and fills fewer bags.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) space to store deficit array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate proves that smallest deficits maximize count of satisfied bags.
